originality.rationale: The exact covariance-theta zero set is established in Katori--Shirai (2020), Proposition 2.2 and Lemma 2.3, and appears as a weighted kernel infinite product in Gafai--Murid--Wahid (2022). The new statement is a minimum over all independent evaluation pairs in the intrinsic complete hyperbolic metric, with its unique extremizing orbit, exact all-weight log-periodic law, sharp half-core-geodesic lower bound, exceptional zero-free weights and logarithmic divergence. Relevant fully inspected primary material and published indexed comparators did not provide or imply this geodesic optimization. A 2023 same-object paper was examined at accessible abstract and landing-page level only; historical priority remains a genuine residual risk.

value.rationale: Zero correlation of two point evaluations is an intrinsic natural optimization question in Gaussian analytic sampling. The exact complete weight classification quantifies how much Poincaré separation is needed for independent values, identifies a sharp systolic geometric threshold and its unique attaining weights, characterizes weights forbidding independent evaluations entirely, and supplies a logarithmic divergence constant near these forbidden weights. These are meaningful precise invariants of this standard family, not a renamed kernel-zero identity; no broader probabilistic mixing theorem is claimed.
